title: Engine sandbox
description: Entirely fictional test content. Names, ages, dates, weights and outcomes exercise engine behavior; they are not historical evidence or population statistics.

origins.title: Riverside household
origins.text: You begin in a fictional riverside household, surrounded by stories and small experiments.

origins.title: Hill household
origins.text: You begin in a fictional hill household with a connection to the local workshop.

events.title: A first page
events.text: The sandbox opens its notebook. This short fictional life is designed to test the engine.

outcomes.text: Your household starts a small notebook of discoveries.

events.title: A way to learn
events.text: A teacher offers lessons. A workshop connection can open a second path.

outcomes.text: Regular lessons give you a foundation to build on.

choices.text: Use your connection to join the workshop.

outcomes.text: You gain a workshop place and begin learning through practice.

events.title: The first errand
events.text: Two things happen at this age. This errand is the first scheduled event in declaration order.

outcomes.text: Several new stories find their way into your notebook.
It is a quiet market day, but you still learn something.

events.title: The second errand
events.text: A message arrives in the same year. Resolving the first errand has not advanced your age.

choices.text: Help read and deliver the message.

outcomes.text: Reading the message gives you practice and earns a little trust.

choices.text: Leave the message to someone else and rest.

outcomes.text: A little rest restores your energy.

events.title: A new calendar page
events.text: The displayed calendar has moved from 1 BCE to 1 CE. There was no year zero.

choices.text: Record the date in your notebook.

outcomes.text: You add a careful note about the calendar convention used by this test world.

events.title: A day to practise
events.text: A spare day offers a chance to test an idea. This random event can recur, with a cooldown.

outcomes.text: The experiment works, and your notebook gains a useful discovery.
The experiment proves tiring and will need another attempt.

events.title: A road out of the sandbox
events.text: You can finish the remaining notebook pages here, or end this test life by leaving now.

outcomes.text: You decide to complete the sandbox's remaining years.

choices.text: Leave the sandbox and end this run.

outcomes.text: You close the notebook and step onto the road.

endings.title: A workshop notebook completed
endings.text: Your workshop studies reach their goal. This conditional ending completes the test life early.

endings.title: Beyond the sandbox
endings.text: You chose to leave. This is an explicit ending effect, not a simulated death.

endings.title: The sandbox is complete
endings.text: You reach the test world's maximum age and complete its notebook. Twelve is a test boundary, not a historical lifespan estimate.
